pages.text: Use the Healing Axe on a living target as a normal attack to give it some of your health. It can transfer up to one heart from you per hit and will leave you at least half a heart. The healing effect harms undead instead.

pages.title: While Held
pages.text: Hold the axe in your main hand or offhand to restore one hunger point every two seconds while hungry. A successful health transfer uses durability.
